messages:
Gina: quick follow-up from the RFC threads 12 — proposing we add a tiny residency hint to the probe so routing decisions can prefer private/dedicated without full manifests. keeps control-plane lightweight.
Harold: curious — how do we avoid leaking tenant metadata in that hint? dedicated customers care about isolation.
Yuki: idea: make it a categorical hint only, e.g. `tenant_residency: [hosted|dedicated|private]` and never include org IDs or region specifics. that should be safe.
Samir: +1 to categorical. also include `residency_strength` enum {"preferred","required","none"} so runtime can decide fallback behavior.
Gina: example probe shape I'm thinking of:
```json
{
  "probe_version":"1.0",
  "capabilities":["streaming","kv_cache","batching"],
  "tenant_residency":"dedicated",
  "residency_strength":"preferred",
  "no_secret_proxy":true,
  "feature_versions":{"kv_cache":"v1"}
}
```
Harold: ops concerns: if residency_strength == required and we can't place on dedicated/private, should we fail fast or queue? we need a clear SLO story.
Yuki: suggest fail fast for required (400-ish) with a clear error code and telemetry. preferred -> best-effort placement with a metric `residency_fallback` tagged true.
Samir: rollout plan: 1) probe endpoint published (adapters return residency hint) 2) control plane honors only `preferred` initially 3) after 2-week canary allow `required` but only for internal tenants 4) enable for enterprise with audit logs and console toggle.
Gina: security/devex note: `no_secret_proxy` default true; secret forwarding must be explicit and audited. add a DPA gating for private/dedicated secret proxy allowlist.
Harold: testing checklist: unit schema, integration test (probe -> route chooses appropriate pool), chaos test where preferred can't be satisfied and we verify metric and fallback path.
Yuki: metric names: `adapter_probe_mode` (capabilities_only|manifest_fallback), `residency_route` (hosted|dedicated|private), and `residency_fallback`. alert if fallback > 2% for 6h.
Samir: implementation nit: use `X-RW-Probe-Ver` header and cache decisions keyed by `compat_hash + residency_hint` to avoid per-request recompute. also include `compatibility_ttl` in probe response.
ops-bot: RFC update queued: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/residency-hint-probe (comments open) :rocket:
Gina: next steps - I'll update RFC with the probe JSON, residency semantics, and the three-step rollout. pinging eng-runtime, eng-platform, and security. short 15m sync tomorrow to sign-off?
Harold: 8:30am PT works for me.
Yuki: added to calendar.
Samir: I'll start a draft integration test harness and sample adapter implementation.
